dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: Taking proper breaks between challenges helps you better face your next hurdle. Whoever designed this challenge clearly put a lot of thought into it.

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: This place is a picture-perfect for a tea party. Pretty relaxing, I'd say.

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: But you know, I've always wanted to suggest we do something other than sip tea. I mean, you can party just fine with wine. Good thing I brought my own drinks...
